title: Oracle Technical Consultant
description:
Job Title: Oracle Technical Consultant
 



  





**Experience:** 
 4–7 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Kochi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Technical Consultant with 4–6 years of hands\-on experience in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle EBS, and Oracle Fusion. The candidate should have strong expertise in Oracle development and reporting tools, including BI Publisher (BIP) and OTBI.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop, customize, and maintain Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion technical solutions.
* Develop complex SQL queries, PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
* Work on Oracle technical development, enhancements, integrations, and support activities.
* Develop and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports, including data models and templates.
* Develop and support OTBI analyses, dashboards, and reports.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and provide root\-cause analysis and solutions.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams.
* Participate in unit testing, system/integration testing, deployment, and production support.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation.



  





 Required Skills
 


* 4–6 years of relevant experience in Oracle technical development.
* Strong hands\-on experience in SQL and PL/SQL.
* Experience with Oracle EBS, preferably R12\.
* Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
* Strong hands\-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP) report development.
* Experience with OTBI reports, analyses, and dashboards.
* Good understanding of Oracle database concepts and performance tuning.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Ability to understand functional requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.



  





 Good to Have
 


* Experience with Oracle EBS R12 technical development.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion technical architecture.
* Exposure to REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, or other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience in implementation, enhancement, and production support projects.



  





 Education
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
